name: Party Host Ω
ability: If at least 1 of your alive neighbors is poisoned or drunk, you can't die.
flavor: Let’s keep this party going all night!

name: Solemdeath Ω
ability: Once per game, you may build a world in front of the Storyteller: learn how close it is to the truth.
flavor: Before the game ends, I would like to Alsaahir guess that...

name: Groundskeeper Ω
ability: You start knowing if your 2 neighbors are the same character type.
flavor: In cleaning up others’ messes, you learn quite a bit about your community.
firstNightReminder: Either nod or shake your head.

name: Paladin Ω
ability: You start knowing 1 player who is not the Demon. If they die, you learn another player who is not the Demon that night.
flavor: A real warrior doesn’t battle with a sword. They fight with their heart.
otherNightReminder: If the player marked *KNOW* died today or tonight, point to the new player marked *KNOW*.

name: Ash Ω
ability: Something bad happens to you. [+Bidoof’s Wheel]

name: Bidoof’s Wheel Ω
ability: Each night, you are given 3 prompts: choose 1 to happen to Ash. If Ash dies, you learn this. [+Ash]
flavor: Hmmmmm what will I do this time?
firstNightReminder: Give 3 prompts. Bidoof’s Wheel chooses 1: apply it to Ash. If Ash died, show Ash's token.
otherNightReminder: If Ash is alive, give 3 prompts. Bidoof’s Wheel chooses 1: apply it to Ash. If Ash died, show Ash's token.

name: Lammia Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player: learn their character, then choose whether they die. If not, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
otherNightReminder: The Lammia chooses a player. Show their character token. The Lammia chooses whether they die. :reminder: If not, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
